To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

higher levels of five SCM practices (strategic supplier partnerships, customer relationships, information sharing, quality information sharing, and postponed activities) can lead to enhanced firm competitive advantage and improved firm performance.

SCM practices are positively related to competitive advantage, competitive advantage is positively related to organizational performance, and SCM practices are positively associated with organizational performance.
SCM practices have a positive impact on organizational competitiveness and performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of SCM practices on the competitive advantage of organizations and their performance, and the mediating role of competitive advantage on organizational performance.
the relationship between SCM practice, competitive advantage, organizational performance, and the mediating role of competitive advantage.
the impact of SCM practices on competitive advantage, organizational performance, and the relationship between competitive advantage and organizational success.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SCM practices can have a significant impact on the performance of the firm, but the effect is indirect, through the mediating variable of competitive advantage.
SCM practices have a positive and significant effect on competitive advantage and that competitive advantage has a positive and significant impact on organizational performance.
SCM practices can lead to competitive advantage, which can lead to organizational performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SCM practices have a positive impact on competitive advantage and performance, but the impact of SCM practices on performance is mediated by competitive advantage.
the SCM practices that are adopted in an organization can have a positive impact on its competitive advantage and organizational effectiveness.
SCM practices can be a source of sustainable competitive advantage and can improve an organization’s performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SCM practices are important for organizations to improve their competitiveness and organizational performance.
SCM practices are a valuable source of competitive advantage and organizational success.
the SCM practices are positively related to competitive advantage and organizational effectiveness.
